personal.name: Dr. Tushar Ganpat Rukari
personal.title: Assistant Professor & Head, Department of Pharmaceutics
personal.bio: A dedicated Pharmacy Academician and Researcher with over 17 years of rich academic and administrative experience. Specializes in advanced pharmaceutics, novel drug delivery systems (NDDS), ocular therapeutics, vesicular drug carriers, and polyherbal formulation designs. Successfully spearheading the Department of Pharmaceutics, mentoring student projects resulting in multiple patents, and driving academic excellence through personalized mentoring.
personal.aboutStatement: I believe in bridging the gap between textbook and real-world clinical applications. My research concentrates on design and development of innovative, scalable, and biocompatible drug delivery carriers to address unmet clinical challenges, especially in novel drug delivery and vesicular carrier systems. As a mentor, I aim to foster curiosity and research-driven thinking among future pharmacy leaders.
